Landing page: /chaos-game for our Short "Random dice draw perfect fractals: the chaos game". Title "Roll a die, draw a fractal". The chaos game: corners of a polygon, roll a die, jump a fraction of the way to the chosen corner, leave a dot, repeat. Free: four presets from the Short, playable and animated (3 corners, jump 1/2: Sierpinski triangle; 5 corners, jump 0.618: pentagon fractal; 6 corners, jump 2/3: hexagon fractal whose hole is a Koch snowflake; 4 corners, jump 1/2 with the rule "never the same corner twice": lace), with a dot counter and speed control. VIP: any number of corners (3 to 12), any jump, custom rules (no repeats, no neighbours, weighted die), colour by corner, millions of points and a 4K PNG export.

stripe:
Update from the owner about Stripe: he puts the Stripe secret key into this project's Replit Secrets himself (STRIPE_SECRET_KEY, if it is not there already). You handle the product and price with that key, so he never has to copy IDs. We are essentially updating this explorer's VIP product:
- If this project already has a VIP product/price (for example a price ID in an env var or in the code), REUSE it as it is, whatever the amount. You may update that product's name, description and metadata in Stripe to describe the new VIP features (name "<Explorer name> VIP", metadata explorer=<this explorer's domain>). Do not change or replace its price. Tell me the amount, currency and type.
- Only if no VIP product exists: search Stripe products by metadata explorer=<this domain> first; if still none, create exactly one Product "<Explorer name> VIP (lifetime)" with metadata explorer=<this domain> and one Price: unit_amount 899, currency usd, one_time, lookup_key "<domain>-vip-lifetime", using an idempotency key so a retry cannot duplicate it.
- Store the price ID where the app reads it (env var or config; it is not a secret).
- Never archive or delete any product, price, customer or payment, and never touch other explorers' products.
- Without a webhook secret: verify the Checkout session on the server at /vip/success and re-check the payment with Stripe at most once per hour per buyer, so a refund revokes VIP.
If STRIPE_SECRET_KEY is missing, stop and tell me; never ask for it in chat. Then continue with the brief. Preview only, do not republish.
